title: Riot Squad BAR EDTN Limited Edition Blueberry Acai Cooler 10ml Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: Blueberry Acai Cooler from the Riot Squad Bar Edition Limited Edition range is a rich and cooling berry blend that pairs sweet, vibrant Blueberry with the darker, mellow notes of Acai. A cool Ice layer runs beneath the fruit to add clarity and a brisk finish, lifting the dense berry notes into a more rounded, refreshing profile. Mint infused This nic salt formula provides a smooth yet tactile throat hit with rapid nicotine delivery, making it ideal for use in MTL (mouth-to-lung) pod systems, vape pens and compact starter kits. Available in 5mg, 10mg or 20mg nicotine strengths. Designed to reflect the sweet and icy intensity of disposable-style flavours, Riot Squad’s Bar Edition range puts layered blends like this into refillable 10ml bottles for better value and convenience. Blueberry Acai Cooler is an excellent choice for vapers who enjoy berry-forward vapes with a crisp edge.
